rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The textual context (e.g. a sentence or a paragraph) of a particular in-text reference pointer, providing the rhetorical motivation for the existence of that citation.
rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has context
rdf:Description.skos1:note: Any FRBR expression that constitutes the range of this property can have at most one particular literal textual content specified through the property `c4o:hasContent`.
